claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; open /demo, wait for the service worker, set the context offline, reload, and assert the sample schedule remains usable

claim: Your schedules stay in this browser.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; choose Start for real, save a schedule containing unique quote/client/payment fields, intercept the full flow, assert no cross-origin URL/body/header contains those fields, and assert the record exists in IndexedDB

claim: Opens a complete two-payment schedule.
sandbox: fresh landing page; click Try it with sample data once and assert the demo banner, HT-084, client, amounts, dates, time zone, payment wording, and export actions are ready

claim: Adds both deadlines to your calendar without typing them again.
where: landing preview, workspace calendar action, README
sandbox: fresh landing page; click the sample action once, then download the ICS and assert the populated deposit and final-balance dates become exactly two events with two alarms

claim: Exports two plain payment instructions.
where: landing steps, workspace export action, README
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; download the text export and assert separate deposit and final balance sections with their amounts and time zone

claim: Copies two plain payment instructions.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; invoke Copy payment instructions and assert the browser clipboard receives both payment sections

claim: Rejects nonexistent daylight-saving times and preserves the chosen repeated time.
where: workspace time-zone help, deadline controls, README
sandbox: fresh /demo; enter the New York spring gap and assert a validation error, then choose the second fall-back occurrence and assert its UTC instant in the ICS download

claim: The app never sends a reminder without user confirmation.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; exercise deposit and final-balance reminders while recording requests and mailto activation; assert none happens before confirmation or after cancel, and the explicit action activates only the editable expected mailto URL

claim: There are no analytics, advertising scripts, or remote fonts.
sandbox: fresh /demo; exercise an edit and export while recording requests, then assert no cross-origin request or remote font is present

claim: A license check sends only the saved license token to Sociobot.
sandbox: fresh workspace with a mocked license endpoint; add schedule text, verify a token, and assert the only endpoint request contains only that token

claim: The app does not add late fees or local invoice rules.
sandbox: fresh /demo; change user payment wording, download instructions, and assert the wording is retained with no late-fee text added

claim: Demo sample changes are not saved.
sandbox: fresh workspace; save a real schedule, snapshot IndexedDB and localStorage, edit and reset the demo, then assert the real snapshots are byte-for-byte unchanged and no sample record is persisted

claim: Downloads a backup file and restores a schedule from one.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; download the backup, change its project name, restore it, and assert the changed data appears

claim: Choose the locale, currency, and time zone. Set your payment wording and reminder timing.
sandbox: fresh demo; change all five settings, then assert the instruction export uses the locale/currency/time-zone/wording and the calendar uses the chosen zone and both reminder lead times

claim: Sociobot opens checkout and verifies returned or pasted license tokens. One schedule is free; $24 unlocks a library for multiple schedules in this browser.
where: landing facts, pricing, workspace license panel, README paid-license sentence
sandbox: fresh contexts; assert the price and checkout URL, then prove invalid-online and unverified-offline return tokens retain one record while mocked valid returned and pasted tokens save and reopen three records

claim: Calendar exports, payment instructions, reminder review, and backup files stay free.
sandbox: fresh unlicensed real workspace; fill a valid schedule and assert calendar/instruction downloads, clipboard copy, reminder review, and backup download all work

claim: This browser stores the license token and its latest verification result.
sandbox: fresh workspace with a mocked valid license; verify it and assert localStorage contains only the two documented namespaced license values

claim: Remove license clears only license data. Clearing this site's browser data clears schedules and license data.
sandbox: fresh real workspace; seed a schedule and valid mocked license, remove the license, then clear origin data through the browser storage protocol and assert all local values are gone

claim: When a license check reports an inactive license, the paid library closes. One free schedule and exports remain available.
sandbox: fresh workspace; mock a valid then revoked license result, force a stale verdict reload, and assert the paid library closes while free exports remain visible

claim: Opens a pre-addressed refund request email.
sandbox: fresh Terms route; assert the 14-day policy text and capture the refund link activation as the expected editable support mailto URL
